title: The Sorrows of Young Werther
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
current_text: In 1775 both the novel and the Werther clothing style were banned in Leipzig, and the novel was also banned in Denmark and Italy (no date given for those two).

sources.quote: both the novel and the Werther clothing style were banned in Leipzig in 1775; the novel was also banned in Denmark and Italy.
sources.title: Wikipedia: The Sorrows of Young Werther

ban_rows.note: Wikipedia, citing Furedi (History Today, 2015), says the novel was banned in Italy and Denmark; Leipzig 1775. No Italian date given.
In 1775, both the novel and the Werther clothing style were banned in Leipzig due to concerns over the 'Werther effect'.
